name: Hamstring Stretch with Rotation
instructions: Stand with one heel forward on the floor, toes lifted, and hinge forward at the hips with a flat back.
Reach the opposite hand toward your front foot.
Rotate your torso and reach the other arm up toward the ceiling.
Hold for a few seconds, then return and repeat for 6 to 8 reps.
longevityNotes: Mobility is use-it-or-lose-it. Ten minutes of daily joint work preserves the ranges that keep you independent — reaching, bending, and getting up from the floor.
overview: A standing or seated hamstring stretch with a thoracic rotation that adds mobility through the trunk.

safetyNotes: Move gently into a mild stretch; avoid if you have acute hamstring or back strain.
